messages.content: What year did Electro first appear?
Electro, associated with Max Dillon, first appeared in The Amazing Spider-Man #9 in 1964.
Tell me about Aunt May.
Aunt May is Peter Parker's aunt and one of the central family figures in his life.
Tell me about the main Spider-Man in Marvel's Spider-Man.
Marvel's Spider-Man presents an experienced Peter Parker as its main playable Spider-Man.
Who is Vulture?
Vulture is a recurring Spider-Man villain associated with Adrian Toomes and advanced flight technology.
How much did The Amazing Spider-Man 2 make worldwide?
The Amazing Spider-Man 2 (2014) earned about $709.7 million worldwide according to The Numbers.
Who is the Lizard?
The Lizard is commonly associated with Dr. Curt Connors, whose scientific work transforms him into a reptilian creature.
Who is Kingpin?
Kingpin, Wilson Fisk, is a major crime boss who has repeatedly conflicted with Spider-Man and other Marvel heroes.
Why is Uncle Ben important to Spider-Man?
Uncle Ben is Peter Parker's uncle and a foundational influence on Peter's moral responsibility as Spider-Man.
Tell me about Carnage.
Carnage is a violent symbiote-linked antagonist, most commonly associated with Cletus Kasady.
Who is Spider-Man's friendship with Human Torch like?
Johnny Storm, the Human Torch, is one of Spider-Man's closest superhero friends and frequent friendly rivals.
Who played Spider-Man in The Amazing Spider-Man films?
Andrew Garfield played Peter Parker/Spider-Man in The Amazing Spider-Man films.
Who is Sandman?
Sandman is a Spider-Man villain whose body can transform into sand and whose classic identity is Flint Marko.
Who is Morbius?
Morbius, Michael Morbius, is a scientifically created living vampire who has appeared as both an antagonist and an uneasy ally in Spider-Man-related stories.
What year did the Lizard first appear?
The Lizard, associated with Dr. Curt Connors, first appeared in The Amazing Spider-Man #6 in 1963.
Who is Venom?
Venom is a symbiote-based character whose relationship to Spider-Man varies between enemy, anti-hero, and uneasy ally depending on the story.
How much did Far From Home make worldwide?
Spider-Man: Far From Home earned about $1.132 billion worldwide according to The Numbers.
Tell me about J. Jonah Jameson.
J. Jonah Jameson is a longtime Spider-Man supporting character and a frequent critic of Spider-Man in many versions of the story.
What is Spider-Man 3 about?
Spider-Man 3 continues the Tobey Maguire series with Peter facing multiple threats including Sandman, Venom, and a new Green Goblin.
How much did Into the Spider-Verse make worldwide?
Into the Spider-Verse earned about $373.8 million worldwide according to The Numbers.
Does Spider-Man heal quickly?
Spider-Man versions often have enhanced recovery, but the exact extent varies by continuity.
Give me a concise explanation of Marvel's Spider-Man (2018) game.
Marvel's Spider-Man is an action-adventure game developed by Insomniac Games and published by Sony Interactive Entertainment.
Why should movie financial figures be source-labeled?
Movie budgets and box-office totals should be labeled as source-reported figures because databases can differ in accounting methods and later reissues.
Tell me about Black Cat.
Felicia Hardy, Black Cat, is a recurring Spider-Man ally and romantic interest whose relationship with Peter is complicated.
Is Peter Parker intelligent?
Peter Parker is frequently portrayed as a highly intelligent scientist and inventor.
Tell me about Sandman.
Sandman is a Spider-Man villain whose body can transform into sand and whose classic identity is Flint Marko.
